_comment: TM102 controller decode map. Payload byte offsets p0..p7 are as delivered by firmware mode 'n' (real 5-byte address). See FINDINGS.md, 'The frame'.

state._comment: Three states, read from every beacon frame. The transmit rate corroborates each one independently.

transitions.armed -> answered: a buzzer answered; p6 says which

winner._comment: Last buzzer to answer. LATCHES - survives Clear and does not change when the same buzzer wins twice, so never use a p6 change to detect a buzz-in; use the armed -> answered transition. Formula confirmed for buzzers 1 and 2; linear beyond that assumed but untested.

button_events._comment: Momentary. Sent twice, 11 ms apart. Useful as a precise timestamp, but unreliable for detection - prefer the state bytes above.
